name: Fundamentals Workflow
description: Child workflow compiled from Workbench container Fundamentals_Workflow.

prompt_policy.user_prompt: Analyze business model, revenue streams, segments, unit economics drivers, and strategic position using evidence_pack and model_input_pack only. Every conclusion cites source_id/metric_id/claim_id.

Deeply analyze historical and current financial quality: revenue growth, margins, cash flow, working capital, balance sheet, profitability, segment economics, and data reliability. Use exact metrics from model_input_pack and cite every metric_id/source_id.
Build a segment-level economics table and explain contribution, margin structure, growth drivers, cyclicality, and missing segment data. Cite metric_id/source_id for every row.
Analyze industry structure, peers, market share, competitive advantages, and threats using registry evidence and peer metrics. Separate verified facts from assumptions.
Synthesize fundamentals into an evidence-dense handoff. Keep financial quality scorecard, segment table, competitive matrix, evidence_pack, and registry references intact.
